people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
translations.bsb: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
translations.asv: Jesus therefore answered them and said, My teaching is not mine, but his that sent me.
